name: game2048
description: A fullscreen 2048 board for ChatGPT. The player slides tiles; the model coaches with a board arrow or plays in counted batches.

interface.longDescription: iPlugin 2048 is a fullscreen sliding-tile puzzle for ChatGPT. Join equal tiles, grow the score, and build the 2048 tile; the board, score, best score, highest tile, and move count stay in one quiet view. Play with the arrow keys, W A S D, or a swipe. Ask ChatGPT for a hint and a large translucent arrow points to the suggested direction while the coach panel gives a one-line reason; the hint never spends a move. Let ChatGPT play in counted batches of up to eight moves, with an eight-step countdown, and press Stop to end after the current batch. Undo the last slide, keep playing past 2048, and keep a persistent best score. The interface follows the ChatGPT client language across 54 locales, including right-to-left layouts. No account, advertisements, analytics, or separate model API. Seven MCP tools; games stay in server memory for the conversation.
